title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The resilience to future emergencies in Afghanistan programme implemented by Concern Worldwide aims to build the resilience of displaced and host communities affected by conflict and natural disasters by providing for their immediate survival needs and supporting them to gain the infrastructure and skills to be more resilient to future emergencies. The objectives of the programme is to provide emergency provisions and shelter, cash, and winterization support; to work with communities and provincial authorities in Takhar and Badakhshan provinces to manage and improve their emergency response in an effective and timely manner; and to support the disaster response capacity of local NGO partners. . This element of the programme is to enable the CHC team to respond to shocks, either climate related such as earthquakes and floods, or man made such as displacement. This element is intended to respond to the humanitarian needs of those most vulnerable and affected by disasters.
